scope: Whole Brasília TV Tower exterior: three curved V-shaped concrete piers and center access/lift core; full mapped triangular glazed mezzanine with structural floor, sloping soffit and roof; open tapering triangular steel transmission lattice, center lift/stairs, observation deck at 75m and smaller service platform, complete red/white upper mast and needle to 224m. Exclude independent park, plaza, fountain, market, landscaping, paths, detached sculpture/art, barriers, signs, vehicles, people, interiors and exhibits. Antenna fixture census and hidden sections are bounded architectural estimates.
